existingReason: callback: Load runs through PkCallbackSlot with typed generics Missing generator features: @typeparam generation (a typed component) and a callback parameter kind (a typed delegate that the generator hands to the element as a PkCallbackSlot, with an adapter from the element's argument and result to the delegate).

params.name: Config
params.note: Sent as a JSON attribute: { columns: [{ key, label, type?, align?, sortable?, hidePhone? }], filters?: [{ key, type, label, options? }], actions?: [{ label, href?, variant? }], empty?: { heading?, description? }, pageSize?, selectable?, rowKey?, bulkActions?: [{ id, label, variant? }] }.

notes: Hand-written (issue #366): load(query) is a callback property, set from script, so the component (PkListPage<TItem>) hands the element a .NET reference (PkCallbackSlot, bridge setCallback) that calls the Load parameter, Func<PkListRequest, Task<PkListResult<TItem>>>. Not a mapped param: the generator only maps props, slots and events. rowHref is synchronous in the element and cannot cross the interop boundary; use Config actions or a row-click handler (later step). Selection (issue 873): Config selectable/rowKey/bulkActions switch it on; OnSelect (pk-select) and OnBulk (pk-bulk, a bulkActions button) are EventCallbacks passed to the element as handlers. For Selected, SelectedChanged, a BulkContent slot and the compacted large selection use PkDataTable.
